description: Remove items from one collection. The items stay in the library and in any other collection they belong to; nothing is deleted. Items that were not in the collection are reported as unchanged.

groupId.description: Group library ID. Omit for the personal library ("My Library"), which is what almost every request wants. Group IDs come from zotero_list_libraries.

itemKeys.description: Keys of the items to remove.

name: zotero_remove_items_from_collection
title: Remove items from a collection
